title: Dispatch order: Even-key census
summary: links is a square 0/1 directed adjacency matrix. Queue all zero-indegree vertices in increasing order; pop FIFO, visit neighbors in increasing order, and enqueue a neighbor when its indegree becomes zero. Produce this vertex order, or no values if a cycle prevents a complete order. Return how many values in the derived sequence are even, including 0 and negative even values.
descriptionMd:
A dispatch board permits a job only after every incoming dependency has been removed. Neri separates readings for the office's even-numbered keys. A zero reading belongs in that count, just like any other even number.

links is a square 0/1 directed adjacency matrix. Queue all zero-indegree vertices in increasing order; pop FIFO, visit neighbors in increasing order, and enqueue a neighbor when its indegree becomes zero. Produce this vertex order, or no values if a cycle prevents a complete order.

Return how many values in the derived sequence are even, including 0 and negative even values.

Implement dispatchOrderEvenKeyCensus(links, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Topological queues. links is a square 0/1 directed adjacency matrix. Queue all zero-indegree vertices in increasing order; pop FIFO, visit neighbors in increasing order, and enqueue a neighbor when its indegree becomes zero. Produce this vertex order, or no values if a cycle prevents a complete order. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.
The adjacency matrix is square and has at most 16 vertices; binary entries are 0 or 1, weighted entries are 0 through 13.

Target time O(V^2); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
